articles.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
articles.description: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
articles.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
articles.description: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
articles.description: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
articles.description: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
articles.description: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
articles.description: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
articles.description: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
articles.description: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
articles.description: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.
articles.author: Marina Temkin
